newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber closes mixed on weak demand.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber closes mixed on weak demand.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were quoted mixed at the close as consumer demand remained weak, traders said.
"We didn't note any inquiries today and no sales either," said a trader.
Dealers said despite the lack of demand, the current low production period, due to wintering, was likely to limit the market's downside.
At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted March RSS1 buyer at 304 cents ($1.23) a kg, unchanged from Friday.
March SMR 20 was half cent lower at 294.
Traders offered the SMR CV at 359, SMR L at 339, SMR 5 at 301, SMR 10 at 297 and SMR 20 at 295.
The INRO five-day average was 232.19 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on March 7 from 232.55 cents per kg on March 6. The daily indicator was at 231.97 against 232.24.
